name: mesh-gradient
summary: Full-bleed hero running Paper Shaders' mesh gradient on WebGL2: four colour points drifting through a swirled, grain-mixed blend, with a designed CSS mesh as the resting state.

colors.description: Two to ten colour points. Omit to read --fx-c1 through --fx-c4 off the section, which is what keeps the shader and the CSS resting state on one palette. Upstream default preset.

speed.description: Drift rate. 0 renders a single static frame. Forced to 0 under prefers-reduced-motion.

distortion.description: Warp applied to the UV before the colour points are sampled. 0 is a clean blend.

swirl.description: Rotation applied with distance from the centre, so the blend twists outward.

grainMixer.description: Noise added to the colour point positions, which frays the boundaries between them.

grainOverlay.description: Film grain composited over the finished blend.
